sign_in.note: The page's only session-establishing request on mount: it needs the refresh cookie (credentials: include). The synthetic identity has no password and no cookie, so no HTTP sign-in exists on the API-runner path: the executor mints the token offline (packet, The identity). On the browser path this request is expected to fail (packet, Branches F).

non_get_requests.what_it_writes: ONE DynamoDB item per distinct (firm, sorted account ids, directory revision): key tenant = the firm token, request_revision = 'SELECTION#' + the content-addressed reference; value = the selection record. Table = the core stack's 'requests' output (directory/lambda.tf:46, performance/lambda.tf:44). Immutable and idempotent: a repeat is a ConditionalCheckFailed that loads and compares the stored record (selection_store.py:46-53); nothing is ever updated or deleted.
non_get_requests.finding_for_the_halves: The page cannot reach any account-level hop without this POST. It is a server-side write by a request the bound does not except. The halves rule whether a content-addressed, immutable, idempotent selection record is inside 'read-only'.

get_requests_with_server_side_effects.effect: A read-through store. With an accepted pointer for the key it reopens (a read, retained.py:281-285). With none it computes and PERSISTS: artifacts.put (retained.py:321), retention.promote (:324), reports.persist (:330), index.publish (:338). The route's own operation_kind says 'read' (performance/entry.py:281).
get_requests_with_server_side_effects.for_the_named_firm: The firm token is the vendor branch, not the holdings branch: COMPOSED_FIRMS holds it (retained.py:78) but _holdings_sources installs holdings sources for two OTHER firms only (performance/installed.py:68), so holdings_firm is false (retained.py:193) and the fresh path takes the vendor branch (retained.py:304-315). That branch needs a server-installed single-use approved plan (authorization.py:65-90) and, when one matches, writes a claim row (authorization.py:94) and makes a vendor call. With no matching plan it refuses (authorization.py:90) before any write. An existing retained vendor figure is refused on reopen (retained.py:259-261).
